gameplay.finance: Consideration bands are descriptive only. No prices, invoices, tax postings, receipts, payments, loans or settlement events are generated.
gameplay.ownership_history: SW-PROPERTY-TENURE-V1 remains the sole source of ownership event facts; this dataset provides title instruments and transaction indexes keyed to source event IDs.
gameplay.physical_changes: Subdivision, consolidation, redevelopment, demolition and change-of-use actions are available as runtime action types but do not alter the baseline until a gameplay event is executed and all dependent records are updated.
gameplay.population: No person, resident, employee, tenant-as-person or population records are created.
gameplay.unknowns: No mortgage, lien, easement, boundary dispute or encumbrance is presumed absent; no source record was supplied, so status remains not asserted.
